description: Hotel offers for a Corissia hotel and date range, API version 2.0, without a guests parameter. The answer may be for a different stay than the requested one: stay.checkin and stay.checkout show the stay it is for. Kept unchanged for the integrations of the first server.

checkin.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2025-06-01.

checkout.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 2025-06-05.

hotel.description: Hotel code: flair, harmony, princess, beach, or hiltonchania.

name: corissia_offers
title: Offers (API 2.0)
